description: pangenome_alignment: one row per record this DATASET publishes. Standalone — the source declares role 'dataset', so its own normalised rows ARE the claim and no xref join was run. Rejected rows are NOT in this view: they are in the run record's normalise block and in rejects/<run>.<source>.tsv, each with the reason it was rejected.
resolution: standalone: no join — one source's own rows, published as normalised (role: dataset)
every column is text: a mapping declares names, not types, so none is invented
a row with an empty key is a reject with a reason, counted — never a dropped row
